facts.fact: Loi de finances rectificative n°25/044 of 28 June 2025 appropriates FC 60,627,481,411, all domestic with no external investment, for Section 71, Numerique, for budget year 2025.
The document gives Section 71 as FC 87,134,433,991 in 2024 and FC 60,627,481,411 in 2025, a fall of about 30%.

The Situation provisoire de l'exécution du budget au 31 décembre 2025 shows Section 71 paid (paiements) FC 31,358,784,468 against a voted credit of FC 60,627,481,411 (51.7%), with FC 68,278,687,329 ordonnanced; the ministry's line, no collections.
The document states Section 71 rises from FC 60,627,481,411 in 2025 to FC 226,713,223,741 in 2026 (+274%), partly a transfer of mandate from Section 52.

note: Spent date is that of the execution table (2026-04-01) for year 2025.
